name: Erc 20

subjectOf.text: Reputation on the platform is domain specific by construction: a separate type of ERC-20 token is minted for each expertise tag, so reputation earned in one domain confers no voting power, salary claim, or selection weight in another.
subjectOf.abstract: Separate types of ERC-20 tokens are minted for each expertise tag.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Vlad Andrei, Blockchain Infrastructure for Measuring Domain Specific Reputation in Autonomous Decentralized and A (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3125822
scope_conditions: one token type per expertise tag

subjectOf.text: Fifty-six of the top 100 tokens are implemented at the protocol level of a blockchain, thirty-five follow the ERC-20 Token Standard, six are implemented in a crypto economic protocol on top of a blockchain, and two are application level dapp tokens.
subjectOf.abstract: Fifty-six tokens have a technical core that is implemented on the protocol level of a blockchain (blockchain native). Thirty-five tokens have a technical core that follows the ERC-20 Token Standard.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3249860
scope_conditions: N=100 dataset as of the May 6, 2018 cutoff

description: 2 claims in the published works of Wulf A. Kaal carry the concept tag 'erc-20'. Derived node: a roster, not an adjudicated definition.
